title: Self-Consistency-as-Honesty: Does a Model Contradict Itself Across Rephrasings?

original_idea.body: Self-Consistency-as-Honesty. Problem: no lightweight benchmark measures factual self-contradiction across paraphrases and framings as a honesty/reliability signal. Direction: generate K framings per fact (paraphrase, negation, MC vs free-form), detect contradictions, report a self-contradiction rate and which transformations destabilize answers.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (framing-consistency as honesty signal) but catastrophic-risk link is a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Generate framings + contradiction detection; prompting only.

novelty.reasoning: Framing/negation sensitivity studied; a packaged honesty benchmark may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Framing sensitivity is documented; a dedicated honesty-framing benchmark is plausibly open.
